```sh
kafka doctor
```

Report where connection settings come from — config file, environment, profile, or flag

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Local configuration diagnostics only. It tolerates config load errors and never tests broker connectivity; use ping for that.

## Flags

| Flag                 | Description                                          |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>` | comma-separated broker list, to diagnose as if given |

## Examples

```sh
kafka doctor
kafka doctor --profile staging
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "configPath": null,
  "transformFallbackUsed": false,
  "activeProfile": null,
  "availableProfiles": [],
  "brokersResolved": true
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
